answer.book: Cunradus Aslakssøn's 1597 Latin treatise De natura caeli triplicis libelli tres, a front-matter section (epigram, dedication to Tycho Brahe, preface, synopsis, scriptural quotations) followed by three numbered books on the air, the starry heaven and the perpetual heaven, each divided into chapters.
